stories.title: Police find no threat to public after report of suspicious activity in Greenfield Valley
stories.summary: North Wales Police found no threat to the public after a report of suspicious activity in Greenfield Valley Heritage Park on Tuesday morning. The force’s North Flintshire team said: At 10.25am today, we received a report of suspicious activity in Greenfield Valley Heritage Park. Officers attended and located the person in question. stories.title: Funded childcare now open to every two-year-old in Flintshire
stories.summary: Every two-year-old in Flintshire can now get 12.5 hours a week of funded childcare, wherever in the county they live. Until this week the places were only open to families in Flying Start areas, a list of 51 parts of the county including parts of Flint, Holywell, Connah’s Quay, Shotton, Mold, Buckley and Sealand. stories.title: Fewer than four in 10 high-risk eye patients in north Wales waiting within target
stories.summary: Fewer than four in 10 of Betsi Cadwaladr’s highest-risk eye patients were waiting within their target time at the end of September, the lowest rate of any health board in Wales. stories.title: Welsh public sector highly unlikely to hit 2030 net zero ambition, Audit Wales finds
stories.summary: The Welsh public sector is now highly unlikely to reach net zero carbon by 2030, according to Audit Wales.
